instructions.value: Participants viewed negative and neutral images and rated their subjective emotional experience on an 8-point scale (1 = Neutral, 8 = Extremely negative). During explicit suppression runs, they were instructed to view and rate the images while trying to suppress the experience and expression of emotional responses. Implicit suppression was induced by constructing grammatically correct sentences from five-word jumbles containing emotion-control words.

instructions.value: Participants indicated by button press whether each image had been previously seen during the emotional rating task and then rated confidence on a 3-point scale.
